reason: The README documents a model-facing image_describe tool that reads local images and uses the DashScope vision API to generate descriptions or answer image questions, with a web paste bridge for text-only models.

summaries.zh: 通过 DashScope 视觉 API 分析本地图片，并为智能体提供图片描述或针对图片的问题回答。
summaries.en: Analyzes local images through the DashScope vision API and provides agents with image descriptions or answers to focused image questions.

capabilities: Reads a local image file from an absolute path or workspace-relative path
Encodes image data and sends it to a configured DashScope-compatible vision API
Returns generated image descriptions or answers to focused image questions
Uploads pasted or dropped images to the host media route for text-only model sessions
